arg.name: description_package
arg.description: Description package with robot URDF/xacro files. Usually not set, it enables use of a custom description.

arg.name: description_file
arg.description: URDF/XACRO description file with the robot.

arg.name: prefix
arg.description: Prefix of the joint names, useful for multi-robot setup. If changed, joint names in controller config must also be updated.

arg.name: use_mock
arg.description: Whether to use mock hardware or real hardware.

arg.name: robot_serial_number
arg.description: Last two digits of the serial number of the robot, used for selecting the correct patched URDF variant.

arg.name: nominal
arg.description: Whether to use the nominal robot description or the patched one for a specific serial number. If true, robot_serial_number arg is ignored.

arg.name: hand_ros2_control
arg.description: Include the hand ros2_control hardware block. Set false when a dedicated hand controller manager is launched separately.

arg.name: no_calib
arg.description: Skip the hand's current-sensing calibration on real hardware and use the motors' current position as the 'open' reference instead.

arg.name: hw_is_async
arg.description: Run the hardware component's read/write in its own thread (true) or in the controller manager's RT loop (false).

arg.name: hw_rw_rate
arg.description: Hardware component read/write rate [Hz]; only used when hw_is_async is true.

arg.name: hw_thread_priority
arg.description: SCHED_FIFO priority of the async hardware thread; only used when hw_is_async is true.

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) $(find-pkg-share $(var description_package))/urdf/$(var description_file).urdf.xacro \ prefix:=$(var prefix) \ use_mock:=$(var use_mock) \ ip_address:=$(var ip_address) \ port:=$(var port) \ session_id:=$(var session_id) \ hand_type:=$(var hand_type) \ robot_serial_number:=$(var robot_serial_number) \ nominal:=$(var nominal) \ hand_ros2_control:=$(var hand_ros2_control) \ no_calib:=$(var no_calib) \ hw_is_async:=$(var hw_is_async) \ hw_rw_rate:=$(var hw_rw_rate) \ hw_thread_priority:=$(var hw_thread_priority) \ ')
